canonical_deduplication: feature column order is non-semantic; standardization is canonicalized to identity for tree families (RandomForest, HistGradientBoosting), while retained for LogisticRegression; feature-operator expansions (original, pairwise interactions, nonlinear marginals) remain distinct executable hypotheses
feature_universe: Caller-supplied isolated development fixture identifiers only; no production feature was added or enabled.
hyperparameters: Small closed deterministic grids in the dev-only module; values are identity-bearing and validated.

evaluation.selection_boundary: No final holdout or production evaluation; every candidate score is diagnostic on synthetic fixture data.

approval_gates: Independent statistical review of chronological split, feature availability, leakage, multiplicity, and uncertainty protocol
Owner approval of feature definitions and prediction-time availability
Versioned amendment to frozen candidate eligibility and benchmark protocol
